title: Migrate Wi-Fi to Netplan
description: Migrate Wi-Fi configuration from wpa_supplicant to Netplan (50-wifi.yaml).

title: Extract Wi-Fi Telemetry
description: Add adaptive_engine and gather_wifi_telemetry to extract deep Wi-Fi metrics via iw and ip commands, feeding real-time network states back to the CMP.

title: Prometheus Blackbox Service Discovery
description: Replace hard-coded, static IPs in the Prometheus scrape.yml with dynamic http_sd_configs for service discovery (/api/v1/telemetry/blackbox-sd).

title: Remote Edge Command Execution
description: Implement _run_remote_sensor_command to SSH directly into physical edge sensors and execute real commands.

title: Real Remote PCAP Capture
description: Add run_real_pcap_capture which executes tcpdump on the edge sensor, retrieves the packet capture via base64 encoding, and saves it for download.

title: WPA2-Enterprise Provisioning UI
description: Add UI support for WPA2-Enterprise (802.1X PEAP), including fields for EAP Usernames and Passwords in the provisioning modal.

title: PCAP Download Resolution
description: Fix the PCAP download buttons to point to the actual saved .pcap files on the backend rather than generating a dummy blob on the client.

title: Captive Portal Auto-Screencast
description: Add an auto-screencast feature that triggers if a captive portal splash page is intercepted.
